blocks.source: Vol III, Context Engineering, § Historical Perspective and Further Reading
blocks.md: Managing bounded fast memory against a much larger backing store is one of the foundational challenges of computer systems. When virtual memory decoupled address spaces from physical DRAM, Belady established the theoretical ceiling for page replacement by comparing online policies against an optimal offline algorithm with clairvoyant knowledge of future memory accesses. Denning grounded this theory in measurable program behavior with the working-set model, defining an empirical working set over a sliding time window to prevent thrashing. Context engineering confronts a similar capacity limit, with one sharp systems difference.

questions.q: The section **Historical Perspective and Further Reading** develops one of the chapter's claims. Which one?
options: Context policies are compared as complete policies on accepted outcomes under a fixed model, tools, budget, and fixture, and retention or compression ratios are diagnostics with explicit denominators, not verdicts.

Before each call the runtime selects a bounded working set and splits the input allowance S_max - K_max among instructions, tool declarations, task state, and observations, and appended observations are the term that grows and displaces task state.
A verified write withdraws current-state authority from bound observations and flags dependent conclusions for reassessment, without erasing their historical truth.

Usable context is an empirical property of a model, configuration, representation, and workload found by decision-level evaluation, because attention dilutes a target key as staged keys accumulate and position matters.
